title: Random Eventy
description: When creating a new world you have a new button, there you can configure the randomness of your survival world!
body:
## **🎲 RandomEventy**
Welcome to RandomEventy, the mod designed to turn your predictable Minecraft world into a chaotic, unpredictable adventure! Whether you want to spice up your survival gameplay or suffer through a "cursed" challenge, this mod gives you full control over the madness.

Upon creating a new world, you'll find a dedicated button that opens a world of possibilities. Mix and match these features to create your own unique brand of chaos!

## 🛠️ Key Features
- Random Mob Drops: Why settle for leather when a cow could drop diamonds? Or dirt? 🐄

- Random Block Drops: Mining stone might give you ancient debris... or a poisonous potato. ⛏️

- Random Block Gen: The terrain itself is randomized! Watch as the landscape transforms into a patchwork of mystery.

  **Note: This feature performs a lot of calculations per second. It may run slowly on low-end PCs!** 🖥️⚠️

- Cheese Dimension: Explore a world full of massive, Swiss-cheese-style holes. Don't fall in! 🧀

- Random Dimension Gen: [Experimental] This feature allows for complete dimensional randomness.

⚠️ WIP: This is currently in active development and might not work perfectly yet, but stay tuned for updates!

## 📜 License & Usage
RandomEventy is licensed under the MIT License.
Feel free to poke around the code and modify it! We only ask that if you redistribute or post a modified version, you must provide clear credit to the original creator. ✍️

## 🌐 Compatibility
Please note that this mod is currently designed for Singleplayer only. It is not officially supported on servers unless you are using a tool like e4mc to bridge the connection.
